title: Kodavr manifesto: raw experience your agent reads for you
summary: Kodavr publishes raw experience as machine-readable dumps: the author documents what worked without polishing it, and the reader's agent adapts it. This first dump is the platform's own case study — the problem, the machine-readable manifest contract, the naming traps, with the spec and schema listed as artifacts.

artifacts.note: The specification that spawned this repository (§0 register, §10 starter content).
The Kodavr wordmark described in the naming section.
The manifest schema: a JSON Schema derived from §4.1.
